is-your-idea-a-real-problem.text: Welcome to The Business of You podcast. This is a short sample preview, read by a computer voice, of episode 1: Is Your Business Idea a Real Problem? Yo walks through the first step of the Business of You framework: how to tell whether an idea solves a problem people will pay to fix, before you spend a dollar. Here are the key takeaways. First: Name the exact person who has the problem. Second: Three quick tests before you build anything. Third: Why everyone is not a customer. The full conversation with Yolanda Butler is coming soon. Until then, find free tools and the newsletter at The Business of You website.
